name: Bisphenol A
what_is: An industrial chemical organic compound used to manufacture polycarbonate plastics and epoxy resins for food packaging.
why_botia: It flags it because it is a potent endocrine disruptor (EDC) linked to PCOS, endometriosis, female infertility, and developmental toxicity.
can_1: Identify warnings or disclosures related to the use of plastic food-contact materials.
can_2: Educate the user on potential BPA leaching risks from heated plastic containers.
cannot_1: Detect the presence of BPA in the food itself through label OCR, as it is a packaging migrant.
cannot_2: Determine if the packaging of the scanned product actually contains BPA or if it is BPA-free.

sources.label: EFSA Scientific Opinion on Bisphenol A (2023)
WHO State of the Science of Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals (2012)
